Return the completed gb_minimize run ID, convergence assessment based only on the final minimization tolerance/stopping criterion, energies and key artifacts including minimized_cfg. Because this is a vacuum-in-x minimization, return/retain the required analysis_followups for relaxed short/long GB periodicity analysis without assuming any repeat ratio.
